description:
Kim Sohye's life changed after being chosen as the empress. Unfortunately, Shoye's life after marriage is not exactly happy. The king, who previously had a concubine, doesn't love her and always insults her. The concubine turned out to have evil intentions for the king. But, slowly but surely the king begins to feel the empress's sincere heart. The feeling of their love began to grow like a flower in bloom.  How does their story continue? Will the empress be strong and fight the king's concubines?

[Original Novel](https://page.kakao.com/content/46356171)
